role: MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) — Shanti Niketan Project
instructions: Answer each question with a short voice note (30–90 seconds is fine). Speak naturally, as if talking to a colleague.

questions.text: Please state your full name, your total years of experience in MEP execution, and your current role and company.
Tell us about the luxury residential project(s) you have worked on. Please name the project, the client or developer, the locality/city, and your specific role and responsibilities.
If you have not worked directly on a standalone luxury residence, tell us about any five-star hotel or ultra-luxury apartment project you have worked on, and what your MEP scope of work was there.
Walk us through how you coordinate MEP services with architects and interior designers on a high-end project, especially when finishes or false ceilings conflict with duct or pipe routing.
Describe a time a vendor delayed delivery or installation and it threatened your project timeline. What did you do?
How large a team have you directly managed on site, and who did you report to?
What is your current CTC, and what is your expected CTC for this role?
What is your notice period, and how soon could you join if selected?
This role is based in Delhi NCR. Are you currently based here, or willing to relocate? Please mention your current location.
Why are you looking to move from your current organization?
